uncited: Vertex Cluster Assignment maps each input point to a discrete voxel cluster ID based on its spatial position within a regular grid.
It solves the problem of discretizing continuous point cloud coordinates into a sparse voxel structure, serving as the core assignment step in `VoxelGrid::CreateFromPointCloudWithinBounds`.
It differs from deterministic ray-casting methods by directly computing grid indices from vertex positions, making it suitable for point clouds rather than triangle meshes.
- **Input:** A point cloud (vertices), an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) minimum (`aabbMin`), a voxel size (`cellSize`), and grid dimensions (`gridDims`).
Write `idx` (or a derived cluster ID) to `clusterSSBO[i]`.
- **Time Complexity:** O(N) where N is the number of vertices.
- **Memory Complexity:** O(N) for storing cluster IDs.
It is part of a pipeline for converting point clouds to sparse voxel grids for volume rendering.
